tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug 'dzin pas phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa zung 'jug gi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shad+dha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de yid mnyam par bzhag sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las yig 'bru 'phros pa yab kyi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkha' nas thon/ yab kyi gsang gnas su zhugs nas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya/ spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ting nge 'dzin/ de thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsams la yul rnams snang zhen med par spyad do// nub mo nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad 'ga' yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ nangs par ldang ba'i tshe lha'i sku'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*// de ltar rgyun tu rnal 'byor du byed cing*/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa la gnas pa ni ring por mi thogs par he ru ka chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// zhes pa'ang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab ngag 'don bklags chog tu bsdebs pa maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgrub thabs bklags chog tu bkod pa bde chen 'byung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru be/ srid zhi'i drwa ba bde chen du// sdom mdzad he ru ka dpal la// btud nas sgrub thabs cho ga'i rim// 'khrul zad gong ma'i gsung bzhin dgod// 'di'i sbyor ba byin rlabs kyi yi ge ltar grub nas cho ga dngos la sngon 'gro/

dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa gsum las dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma byin rlabs bsdus pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ 'bar ba'i rgya dang*/ phaiṃ zhes mgron spyan drang*/ rdo thal phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣas/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+mā da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ grih+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhiṃ me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thi baṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhu ñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarbā kā ra ta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā si kā bha ban+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum mo// rdo rje dril thabs dang bcas pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs= /srin po'i= /'byung po'i= /yi dwags= /sha za'i= /smyo byed= /rjed byed= /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs= /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang sogs nas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/ces phrin las bcol/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma la sogs pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig sum+bha bzlas drag rol bya gtor ma phyir dor/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ rol mo byin 'bebs kyi sngags sogs brjod/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la=

dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum mam bdun/ sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi bdag bskyed ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar po dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug 'dzin pas phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa zung 'jug gi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de yid mnyam par gzhag

sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las yig 'bru 'phros pa yab kyi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkha' nas thon/ yab kyi gsang gnas su zhugs nas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab/ byin rlabs skabs mdun bskyed dang bum pa bsgrub/ mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la gong ltar byin brlab/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ nas badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar// dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi// me tog de ring bzhes nas su// 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ nas badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsan+dan ga bur dang bcas pa'i// dri zhim spos me dge ba yi// mthu dang ldan par bya ba 'di// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ= badz+ra dhā paṃ= oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms par byed// lha yi mig 'byed bkra shis pa// mar me khyed kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ= badz+ra dī paṃ= oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa// sna tshogs ga bur rnam brgyan pa// sna tshogs yi ge hūm̐ las byung*// dri 'di 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/

oṃ= badz+ra gan+dhe= oṃ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i// bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan// thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol// oṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= oṃ pa ṭā ha dang cang te sogs// dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang*// yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs rnams// 'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod 'bul/ nang mchod bsang sbyang*/ sngon gtor ltar byin brlabs la/ phaiṃ/ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snying po'i sngags dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sogs yid dam gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi lce/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg la 'bru gsum brjod pas las kyi lha mchod par bsam/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpal ldan ye shes kyi mgon po la sogs pa chos skyong srung ma dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi phul/ bstod pa spro na rkang brgyad sbyar/ mi shes pa'am mi lcogs na/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// bstod par 'os pa thams cad sogs bya/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ byin rlabs nas bzung nang mchod ltar 'bul/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sngags tsam gyis 'bul ba'i mthar/ bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas ba la dang ma da na gtso bor gyur ba'i tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa bshams la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'og tu yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i tshogs rdzas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis brlab/ na mo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li ka lī/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa de nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ na mo nas/ 'di nyid dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams= dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje'i spun grogs rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang*// mos gus gzhom med pho brang na// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin 'thibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin phob la// tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// gu ru de ba sogs/ stug po'i zhing khams 'jig pa med// dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum sde'i dbus// 'khor lo sdom pa bcom ldan 'das// 'dod chags rdo rje 'od dpag med// rnam 'phrul=

/mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga' zhing*// dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod gnas// 'khor lo sdom pa'i bde skyed yum// rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso// rnam 'phrul= /sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas// rab song gnas kyi bdag po mchog /dpa' bo chen po yab yum yang*// rnam 'phrul= /bdud tshogs kun 'dus pho brang dang*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yang*// rnam 'phrul= /bdud tshogs kun 'dul phrin las zhing*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa'i// chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas kyang*// rnam 'phrul sogs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldem// dar gyi cod pan pur ru ru// rgyan cha mang po khrol lo lo// rol mo mang po dir ri ri// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde shar ra ra// sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne// gtad med rig pa sal la la// brjod med dbyings su thal la la// bde ba chen po khril li li// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di la byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// 'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres// gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dzñā na ā be sha ya a ā/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang*/ gtso bo yab yum la snying po'i mthar/ a kā ro gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/

shā sa na'i sngags kyis chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phaiṃ/ badz+ra ā ral+li sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang*/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa bzhes// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing*// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen por mnyes gyur cig /ces 'bul/ gnas skabs thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bas spyi bor bla ma dang lha/ lte bar chos skyong dang 'byung po thams cad dmigs la mchod par bsam zhing longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus la dam tshig gi kha phru gdab/ me sgron btsugs/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ a kā ro lan gsum/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i 'byung po 'chol ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga blta bar mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ sum+bhas bsang*/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ smon lam bkra shis bya bar gsungs pa gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar grub na legs/ mdor bsdu na/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa 'dis ni lha mo 'di dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa tsam bya/ byin rlabs dang 'brel na skabs 'dir sbyar ro// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la gong ltar byin brlab/ sngags tsam gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa bya/ yig brgya dang*/

ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥzhes pas mdun bum gyi lha nam mkhar 'phags/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes rnam lnga 'dod skor gyi rgya bcas rang la bstim/ rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrung*/ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan// 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan// rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan// he ru ka dpal de dang sngags pa lhan cig gar byed shog /ces dge ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ting nge 'dzin/ de thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsams la yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad par gsungs so// tshe gcig sangs rgyas nges ster ba// yang snying 'khor lo sdom pa zhes// grags pa gsal ldan lam bgrod nas// bde chen bde ba'i gar byed shog /ces rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos phyag thor bkod pa'i dgongs bzhed skong phyir blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes tswa 'dra rin chen brag he ru ka dgyes pa'i sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
